experiences.name: Nevis Bungy Jump
experiences.description: Leap from New Zealand's highest bungy platform at 134 meters above the Nevis River gorge. This iconic AJ Hackett experience offers a 8.5-second freefall with breathtaking views of the surrounding Remarkables mountain range. Includes transport from Queenstown and a commemorative certificate.

experiences.name: Routeburn Track Great Walk
experiences.description: Hike one of New Zealand's nine Great Walks, a stunning 32km trail through Fiordland and Mount Aspiring National Parks. Trek past alpine meadows, glacial lakes, and dramatic mountain passes with panoramic views of the Southern Alps. A multi-day hike best done as a guided day section for budget travelers.

experiences.name: Franz Josef Glacier Valley Walk
experiences.description: Explore the terminal face of the famous Franz Josef Glacier on a self-guided valley floor walk. Marvel at the ancient blue ice formations, glacial streams, and lush rainforest surroundings unique to the West Coast. Combine with a guided ice hike upgrade for a more immersive glacial experience.

experiences.name: Milford Sound Kayak and Hike Combo
experiences.description: Paddle through the majestic Milford Sound fiord surrounded by towering peaks and cascading waterfalls, then hike the Milford Track section near the sound. Spot dolphins, seals, and penguins in their natural habitat while experiencing one of the world's most dramatic landscapes from water level.

experiences.name: Hangi Feast and Maori Cultural Experience
experiences.description: Immerse yourself in authentic Maori culture with a traditional hangi meal cooked underground using heated stones. Witness powerful haka performances, learn about Maori navigation and heritage, and enjoy slow-cooked lamb, kumara, and vegetables infused with earthy smoky flavors unique to this ancient cooking method.
